texts.en:
The frenzied melee finally falls quiet in the [event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName] system. The Forge goes dark. Wreckage drifts through cooling light as emergency beacons stutter back to life.

"What a spectacle!" the CFL commentator roars, voice raw with unfeigned emotion. "That's what we came for! That's what the galaxy tuned in to see!"

Third place is no shame, only proof we belonged on the broadcast. Even at the lowest step of the podium, we can look down on the fleets we broke.

label.zh: 我们的舰队飞行得很好！

“多么壮观的场面！”冠铸秀解说员嘶吼着，声音因真情流露而变得沙哑。“这就是我们来的目的！这就是全星系观众拭目以待的时刻！”

第二名索然无味！我们伸出[Species.GetHandName]想要夺取奖杯，却眼睁睁看着它被别人抢走。好吧，让他们庆祝去吧。我们会记住这一切。当锻炉再次召唤时，我们绝不会再输。
texts.en:
The frenzied melee finally falls quiet in the [event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName] system. The Forge goes dark. Wreckage drifts through cooling light as emergency beacons stutter back to life.

"What a spectacle!" the CFL commentator roars, voice raw with unfeigned emotion. "That's what we came for! That's what the galaxy tuned in to see!"

Second place tastes like ash! We stretched out our [Species.GetHandName] to grab the trophy only to see it snatched by another. Well, let them celebrate. We will remember. And when the Forge calls again, we won't lose.

label.zh: 要是我们当时再把舰队升级一下就好了……
label.en: If only we had upgraded the fleet a little more...

第一名！在全星系的崇拜目光中，我们从冠铸秀组委会手中夺走了奖杯并将其高高举起。这次胜利的余响将远传至赛场之外。

现在，整个星系都将对我们的舰队心生畏惧。
texts.en:
The frenzied melee finally falls quiet in the [event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName] system. The Forge goes dark. Wreckage drifts through cooling light as emergency beacons stutter back to life.

"What a spectacle!" the CFL commentator roars, voice raw with unfeigned emotion. "That's what we came for! That's what the galaxy tuned in to see!"

First place! Bathed in the galaxy's adoration, we tore the trophy from the CFL crew and raised it high. This victory will echo far beyond the arena.

Now the galaxy knows to fear our fleets.

我们没有获得名次。奖杯上不会刻下我们的名字，观众们也将转向更耀眼的明星。我们必须回去。
texts.en:
The frenzied melee finally falls quiet in the [event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName] system. The Forge goes dark. Wreckage drifts through cooling light as emergency beacons stutter back to life.

"What a spectacle!" the CFL commentator roars, voice raw with unfeigned emotion. "That's what we came for! That's what the galaxy tuned in to see!"

We did not place. The trophy will not carry our name, and the crowd will move on to brighter stars. We have to return.

label.zh: 谁会在乎这种无意义的比赛？
label.en: Who even cares about a pointless contest?
